zh.title: 民用航空巡邏隊訂購 21 架塞斯納活塞飛機
body: 民用航空巡邏隊 (CAP) 向 Textron Aviation 訂購 21 架塞斯納活塞飛機，包含 7 架 Cessna Skyhawk 172、11 架 Cessna Skylane 182、2 架 Cessna Turbo Skylane T182T 以及 1 架 Cessna Turbo Stationair HD 206。
Textron Aviation 預計於年底前完成全數交付，將增強 CAP 現有 543 架單引擎機隊的任務備妥狀態。
自 2024 年 10 月起，CAP 累計飛行近 20 萬小時、執行 860 起搜救任務並救回 104 人，展現龐大運作價值。

en.title: Civil Air Patrol orders 21 Cessna piston aircraft for emergency response and training
en.summary: Order includes 7 Skyhawk 172, 11 Skylane 182, 2 Turbo Skylane T182T, 1 Turbo Stationair HD 206; delivery by year‑end.
body: The Civil Air Patrol (CAP) has placed an order for 21 Cessna piston aircraft from Textron Aviation, comprising seven Cessna Skyhawk 172s, eleven Cessna Skylane 182s, two Cessna Turbo Skylane T182Ts and one Cessna Turbo Stationair HD 206.
Textron Aviation expects to deliver all 21 aircraft by year‑end, expanding CAP’s existing fleet of 543 single‑engine aircraft and boosting mission readiness.
Since October 2024 CAP has flown nearly 200,000 hours, completed 860 search‑and‑rescue missions and saved 104 lives, underscoring its operational value.
